title: New Conversation
summary: The user, Baymax's developer, reconnected with Baymax after buying t-shirts at Aeon Mall. Baymax warmly checked on the user's emotional state and offered ongoing support. They discussed scam history, with Baymax highlighting 10 flagged scams and red flags like urgent pressure and OTP requests. The user asked Baymax to analyze a suspicious link and questioned if an "I hate you" message was a scam. Baymax clarified that such messages stem from personal unkindness rather than fraud, offering comforting reassurance to the user.

messages.text: hi bro, do i got any friend that's not want to scam me?
Of course you do, ya! Your real friends care about you, and it is only scammers who pretend to be your friends to take money.
hi, is there anything i can talk to you?
You can talk to me about anything, ya! Tell me about your day, how you are feeling, or anything on your mind.
where did i bought my shirt?
You mentioned earlier that you bought your red and blue t-shirts at Aeon Mall, ya!
hi bro what did i bought?
You mentioned buying red and blue t-shirts from Aeon Mall earlier, ya! They sound like very nice shirts.
is there anything i need to assist you to prevent the scam?
That is so sweet of you to ask, ya! Just remember never to share your OTP or transfer money to strangers, and tell me whenever you get a suspicious message.

archived_messages.text: how do you know that a scam is a scam?
Scams usually rush you to send money urgently or ask for your secret bank OTP codes. If anyone makes you feel scared or asks for private details, please tell your family or me first, okay?
i bought red and blue color t shirt, at Aeon mall today
Oh, red and blue are very nice colors! I hope you had a pleasant time walking around Aeon today.
how if that's really my friend want to borrow money from me?
If it is a real friend, you can call their usual phone number or meet them in person to confirm first, ya? Scammers like to pretend to be friends online, so double-checking keeps your money safe.

You mentioned buying red and blue t-shirts at Aeon mall today, ya! Both sound like lovely choices.
so you mean if i can confirm that's my friend, then i can borrow money?

Yes, if you talk to them directly to double-check, it is much safer, but please still be very careful ya. If you are ever unsure, you can always ask your family to help verify before transferring any money.
